what_happened: Sudden release without warning breached Ranganadi embankment; North Lakhimpur (Assam) flooded. 22 deaths as reported by Assam Times.
impact_note: North Lakhimpur town and nearby areas flooded; embankment breached at 10 points and 7.8 km of it collapsed. No count of people affected found in sources.

what_happened: Release from the dam flooded Aamtola and other areas of Lakhimpur. Exact date and casualties not reported in sources found.
Release of about 1,412 cumecs flooded Lakhimpur villages; then-CM Sonowal told NEEPCO not to release water while downstream was flooded. 11 people died in the district flood.
impact_note: Lakhimpur district-wide totals for the flood (Scroll): 15,000+ affected, 11 dead, 1,000+ in relief camps, 11 houses washed away in Majgaon alone, 5,000+ animals died. Dam release was one cause alongside heavy rain and a weak embankment.

what_happened: Penstock leaked at several places during first water filling, blamed on faulty welding; commissioning delayed.
Landslides from 26 May damaged diversion tunnel cladding; the river breached the temporary coffer dyke on 19 June. NHPC said this posed no threat to the dam or downstream.
Two guard walls collapsed in early June after heavy rain and a landslide; the river later flooded the powerhouse (reported 23 Jul).

type: Flood the dam failed to control
what_happened: Guard wall collapsed; floodwater overtopped the main dam for three days and entered the powerhouse.
impact_note: Floodwater over the dam for 3 days; 97 revenue villages in Lakhimpur flooded, 91,436 people and 4,084 ha of crops affected (Sentinel Assam). Heavy rain in the catchment was the main driver.

what_happened: Powerhouse protection wall partially collapsed; CEA asked NHPC to reassess slope stability and worker safety.
Large sinkhole opened on the left bank, damaging diversion tunnel 2.
source: India Today NE; Sentinel Assam; SANDRP

what_happened: Temporary guard wall collapsed; floodwater entered the powerhouse; workers evacuated.
source: India Today NE; Arunachal Times; SANDRP

what_happened: A large section of hill on the left bank slid into the river, raising big waves and hitting the diversion tunnels; main dam work had already been halted.
Part of a hill about 200 m upstream of the dam collapsed after heavy rain, affecting the diversion tunnels. NHPC said the main dam was not damaged.

Landslide blocked the only working diversion tunnel; river downstream ran dry for about 12 hours. One worker was killed and several injured (27 Oct). Centre treated it as a major dam failure under the Dam Safety Act.
impact_note: Subansiri ran dry downstream for about 12 hours; concerns over fish, dolphins and riverside Mising communities. No count of people affected.
source: Arunachal Times; NE Now; The Hills Times; SANDRP

what_happened: Landslide on the right bank of the project after heavy rain; rocks fell from about 200 m up. One worker died.
Release from the dam plus heavy rain flooded 243 villages in Lakhimpur, Assam; embankment breached. 2 people died.
impact_note: 243 villages flooded in Lakhimpur; thousands of families evacuated (no exact count reported); embankment breached at Aamtola.

what_happened: Guard wall beneath Spillway Gate Block 6 washed away; NDSA ordered extra grouting, delaying commissioning.
Flash flood hit the NEEPCO colony and Poosa village; about 18 colony quarters were washed away. 1 person died and 4 went missing. NEEPCO says local heavy rain, not dam operation, caused it.
impact_note: 108 households (~350 people) affected; 54 houses affected, 30 of them destroyed; about 60 in a relief camp; 17 injured (Assam Tribune). SANDRP points to the collapse of an under-construction retaining wall; NEEPCO says local rain caused it.
source: Assam Tribune; Down To Earth; SANDRP
